thread:
alex (Accounting): Received INV-2026-07-02 from Nebula Cloud for $14,750 — PDF has no PO, AP auto-match failed, holding payment.
ravi (Procurement): can you upload the invoice?
alex (Accounting): uploaded INV-2026-07-02.pdf
morgan (Platform): this looks like the dedicated cluster overage we used during the April migration. we thought procurement would augment the PO.
ravi (Procurement): searching PO system: closest is PO-810900 for Nebula Cloud $13,000 created 2026-02-15. amount mismatch $1,750. routing requires PO number to auto-send to approver.
sylvie (FP&A): budget note: we have contingency capex for migrations but need manager approval for >$1,000 variances. who is approver?
morgan (Platform): approver for platform infra is me, up to $5k. can approve but need a clear audit trail.
ebula-cloud (vendor): Nebula support: the $1,750 is for peak-hour premium on 2026-04-10; we can reissue invoice with PO if you provide number or accept a one-line invoice referencing PO-810900 plus surcharge.
alex (Accounting): AP policy: invoice must reference PO or we create an exception PO. prefer vendor reissue.
ravi (Procurement): two options: (A) ask vendor to reissue referencing PO-810900 (clean), (B) create amendment PO-810900-AMP-01 for $1,750 and route to morgan for approval. which do you want?
morgan (Platform): vendor reissue is cleaner. request reissue and also include line-item detail (dates and hours). i'll approve amendment only if vendor can't reissue within 48h.
ravi (Procurement): opening ticket V-1223: "Request reissue INV-2026-07-02 referencing PO-810900 or provide itemized surcharge details." cc: morgan, alex.
ap-bot: vendor ticket V-1223 created.
alex (Accounting): put payment hold HOLD-2218 on INV-2026-07-02, reason: missing PO / amount variance. due date 2026-08-01.
sylvie (FP&A): FYI if amendment needed include GL 5600-platform and cost center PLAT-ENG. otherwise we can't tag in financials.
nebul a-cloud (vendor): sorry for typo in username - Nebula Cloud here. we'll reissue today with PO-810900 and attach usage detail. expect INV-2026-07-02-REV by EOD.
morgan (Platform): thanks, if they reissue i'll sign the approval in procurement tool so AP can match.
alex (Accounting): will remove hold once reissued invoice received and PO field present. update thread when vendor sends revision. :white_check_mark:
